current_date: March 2026 (approved by Planning and Rights of Way Committee 10 March 2026)
current_evidence: The council's 'Apply for planning permission' page links this as the 'Guidance Note on the Validation Requirements for Planning Applications 2026' and says it was approved by the Planning and Rights of Way Committee on 10 March 2026. The document text is dated March 2026.

issues.detail: Several Local List sections are missing from app_type_rows: s8 Transport Assessment/Statement (where significant vehicle movements are generated, scoped with the Highways Authority/National Highways); s10 Planning and Health (proposals with potential health impacts must reference the Spatial Planning and Health Framework 2025-2030); s13 Groundwater and Surface Water Protection (hydrogeological/hydrological assessment for most mineral extraction or waste disposal to land); s15 Trees (works affecting trees/hedgerows; arboricultural survey for large or well-treed sites); s22 Statement of Community Involvement; s23 Rights of Way (where a right of way is temporarily or permanently affected); s24 Landscape and Visual Impact (where likely to affect landscape character/visual amenity); s25 Coal Mining Risk Assessment (Development High Risk Areas); s27 Aviation Impact (aerodrome safeguarding zones; bird management for wetland restoration).
issues.evidence: Guidance Note March 2026, Part Two Local List sections 8, 10, 13, 15, 22, 23, 24, 25, 27

issues.detail: This is a county planning authority, so its applications are minerals, waste and Regulation 3 (county council's own development such as schools). Grokbot placed almost all requirements under 'Full planning' as 'INFERRED' and left 'County own devt (Reg 3)' with no requirements. Under 'Minerals & waste' it lists only a DAS and 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details'. The source applies the local list across county applications (minerals/waste and Reg 3 school proposals, e.g. school travel plans, pupil/staff numbers).
issues.evidence: Notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning'; source s5: school proposals need pupil/staff numbers and parking

issues.detail: 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' under Minerals & waste is a mis-mapping. The excerpt is s6 Design guidance that design considerations for major waste facilities (e.g. energy-from-waste) go in the Planning Statement. It is not a bin-storage requirement.
issues.evidence: 'major waste management facilities, such as energy from waste facilities, can have significant built elements which need to be well designed'

issues.detail: Several triggers are swapped or cut off. 'Lighting Assessment' carries the sunlight/daylight trigger, while 'Sunlight to gardens' carries the external-lighting text (s21.2: a layout plan with beam orientation where significant external lighting is proposed). The 'Ecological Survey' excerpt is BNG 30-year securing text, not the s18 trigger (EcIA for major development, PEA for other development). The 'Drainage Strategy' excerpt is just the fragment 'systems including Sustainable Drainage Systems (SUDS).' The 'Flood Risk Assessment' excerpt omits the trigger (FZ2/3a/3b; 1ha+ in FZ1).
issues.evidence: s12: FRA needed for new development in Flood Zones 2, 3a and 3b and 1 hectare or more in Flood Zone 1

issues.detail: The Heads of Terms trigger is understated. The source requires them only where pre-application discussions made the need clear (e.g. lorry routeing, off-site BNG), which Grokbot's excerpt does not convey.
issues.evidence: s11: Draft Heads of Terms only where made clear in pre-application discussions

issues.detail: Most tab_items are process text, not requirements: validation timescales (3-5/10 working days), the invalid-applications paragraph, electronic submission instructions/email, PDF format advice, the paper submission paragraph, and a list of noise guidance references (ProPG, BB93, BS 8233). The 'Photographs / Photomontages' row ('All photographs should be submitted in PDF file format') is a file-format rule, not a requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Most minor applications will be reviewed... within 3 to 5 working days'; '1.19 All photographs should be submitted in PDF file format.'

issues.detail: The list date was taken from PDF CreationDate metadata. It happens to match the text ('March 2026'; committee approval 10 March 2026), so the date basis should cite the text and approval date instead.
issues.evidence: Council page: approved by Planning and Rights of Way Committee on 10 March 2026

summary: Grokbot's link is the current March 2026 Guidance Note (approved 10 March 2026). The extraction misses about nine Local List sections (Transport, Health, Groundwater, Trees, SCI, Rights of Way, LVIA, Coal Mining, Aviation), assigns everything to 'Full planning' instead of county minerals/waste/Reg 3 types, and contains several swapped or process-text items.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
